headline: A Seaside Swing Installation / XBTW OFFICE
context: "Coral" is a swing art installation located at the northwest corner of West Park at Longfor Puti Coast in Yantai , China. Facing tidal flats and sea, the site is shaped by the daily rhythm of tides, sea breeze, and sunsets, which together form its most distinctive landscape.
